# Raw Umber Studios

> > A UK-based art education platform offering live workshops, online courses, and extensive libraries of video tutorials and reference imagery for figure and portrait drawing.

Raw Umber Studios is an art school based in Stroud, UK, providing both in-person intensive workshops and a comprehensive online subscription service. The platform features curated video tutorials, searchable reference photo libraries, and live drawing sessions led by professional artists including Danny Ferland, Mike Sykes, and other instructors.
